notes: Modified cash basis; roll-forward uses governmental funds Total column (p3-4). Transfers net to zero in the total column (GF -96,196, nonmajor +96,196), so transfers_in/out are null. Debt service 633,340 split into principal 491,822 and interest/other 141,518 using the Special Building Fund schedule (p15). Balance sheet from the net position section of the Statement of Activities and Net Position (p2); no liabilities. School Nutrition kept as governmental because the district reports it in governmental funds. Detail covers the budget-and-actual schedules for the General (more detailed than the combining schedule, not double counted), Depreciation, Activities, School Nutrition, Special Building and QCPU funds (pp8-17); the Combining schedules (pp6-7) were not recorded in detail. Depreciation Fund has no printed totals; its budgeted capital outlay (61,706) had no actual. General Fund budget schedule gives only total budgets, so budget_final is null per line. State and federal program disbursements in the GF schedule are reclassified into Instruction on p6 (360,769), not transfers. Read pages 1-17 of 17. Balance sheet (user 2026-10-27): governmental lines from the governmental funds statement of assets, liabilities and fund balances (p5), Total Governmental Funds column.
